items.headline: 31st AGM approves Rs 2 dividend, director reappointments; demerger scheme update discussed
Board approves scheme to demerge Vertical A (Rs 1,374 cr revenue) and Vertical C (Rs 328 cr) into two listed WOS; 1:1 share entitlement
Q1FY27: consolidated net profit declines 6.11% YoY; revenue Rs 614.7 cr, EPS Rs 7.36
Q4FY26 results: EPS Rs 14.59, revenue Rs 8.73b (-2.6% vs estimate)
Todi family settlement; board gives in-principle nod to three-way demerger into separately listed verticals
